description: Manage evroc storage resources (buckets, file stores, bucket service accounts, S3 credentials). Trigger on storage/S3 keywords. Block on compute/IAM/network/Think.

cases.query: Create an evroc bucket called app-logs
Copy my local backup.tar.gz to the evroc bucket backups
cases.rationale: Object copy operation on evroc storage

cases.query: Create an NFS file store on evroc in zone a
Create a bucket service account that can access my-logs and my-data buckets
Create a load balancer on evroc
Upload my script to the evroc bucket my-bucket
expected_behavior: Runs evroc storage bucket get-s3-credentials first if not already present
Warns that bucket copy requires credentials in ~/.evroc/credentials.ini
Uses evroc storage bucket copy with --from and --to
Verifies with evroc storage bucket list

cases.query: Delete my evroc bucket and everything in it
expected_behavior: If object locking is enabled, warns that --purge is ignored
Does not use --purge on an empty bucket (simple delete is enough)
Verifies with evroc storage bucket get (should return not found)

cases.query: Create a bucket with object locking so I can retain files for 30 days
expected_behavior: Does NOT confuse with Versioned mode (which is for versioning, not locking)
